pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/25103

Updates the test to 
* run on Windows-only to avoid the need to have the runtime available 
* avoids using IdentityUI since that package doesn't work with this very well (Identity UI splits views in to a separate assembly).

issue_context.title: Investigate why SingleFileExe tests fail in Helix
issue_context.body: As part of https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/24925 we added tests to verify views + singlefile exe work. These appear to be failing on Helix. I've verified on a couple of different clean machines that the changes work correctly. I suspect the test setup isn't correct. Punting it to get the feature in.
